input.note: Rests on mechanical recordings rather than on anyone's account: the vault's own usage record (USAGE:2026-08-05 — one failed ost_read_repo call out of 583 invocations), a whole-corpus count over .ost-agent/evidence/TRANSCRIPT_*.md taken this pass (101 occurrences of the permission denial across 84 of 423 session records), and named transcript records carrying the shape (TRANSCRIPT:93a613dc, :89a95209, :f1c62e34, :92acf647). Agent self-observation captured as it happened, so it grounds feasibility and usability — never demand.
